rationale: The reporter says the failure is deliberate behaviour introduced by #19991 (uv build errors when the cache dir is inside the source tree) and asks for it to be relaxed for the GitLab CI pattern, where the cache must live in the project dir. No docs contract is violated by the error itself, so this is a request for different behaviour (enhancement/follow-up to #19991), not a bug. The reproduction is clear without an MRE.
